title: LLM Agents Perform Controlled Experiments Using Simulation Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.23622v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities in reasoning, planning, and tool use, but many scientific and engineering tasks require more than plausible text and code generation. They require understanding how a system responds to intervention, which in practice depends on controlled experimentation. In this work, we propose a multi-agent framework that enables LLM agents to conduct controlled experiments with scientific simulation models for pharmaceutical process design. Given a user query and a baseline configuration, the system constructs a structured task representation, designs experiments, executes comparative simulation, interprets the resulting outcomes, and synthesizes evidence-based recommendations for process parameter optimization. translated_title: 大语言模型代理使用仿真模型进行受控实验
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23622v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大型语言模型（LLMs）在推理、规划和工具使用方面展现出强大的能力，但许多科学和工程任务需要的不仅仅是合理的文本和代码生成。它们需要理解系统对干预的响应，而这在实践中依赖于受控实验。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个多代理框架，使LLM代理能够使用科学仿真模型进行受控实验，用于制药工艺设计。给定用户查询和基线配置，该系统构建结构化任务表示，设计实验，执行比较仿真，解释结果，并综合基于证据的工艺参数优化建议。通过将语言模型与高保真仿真模型在交互式代理框架中耦合，所提出的系统支持通过干预、比较和观察进行推理。
tldr: 本文提出一个多代理LLM框架，通过结合高保真仿真模型执行受控实验，实现制药工艺参数的自动化设计与优化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-agent LLM framework that conducts controlled experiments with high-fidelity simulation models to automate pharmaceutical process design and parameter optimization.
